sentences.text: After a two-year journey, ESA's Hera probe arrives at the binary asteroid Didymos.
Its target is the small moon Dimorphos, which NASA's DART spacecraft deliberately struck in 2022: the impact shortened the moon's orbital period by thirty-three minutes.
Hera is now slowly closing in on the pair and over the coming weeks will settle into orbit from tens of kilometres away.
The CubeSats it carries, Milani and Juventas, will measure Dimorphos's mass and internal structure; the first close-up images are expected in late November.
The approach path you are watching is the planned trajectory ESA supplied to JPL Horizons, published up to 4 November; what follows has not yet been announced.
